title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Monday, 14 September 2026
description: Today: Anthropic forecasts a profitable quarter as Fable 5.1 tops a new Real-SWE benchmark; two AI safety researchers depart Anthropic and Google DeepMind for METR; Australia's only nuclear reactor marks 20 years; Brisbane's parking-fine haul nears $35 million; and Gold Coast's Spit gets its first residential development plan. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
